title: Dylan White - Rift Wizards Showcase
speaker: Dylan White
description:
This talk is from the 2020 virtual Roguelike Celebration:
https://roguelike.club/event2020.html

Dylan White is an independent game designer and programmer. Rift Wizard is his first title, and is currently available in early access on Steam. He shows off gameplay from Rift Wizards and discusses the design and features of the game.

Rift Wizard: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1271280/Rift_Wizard/
